__NOTOC__ Greymane's Resolve is a combat buff that can be acquired by Alliance players every four hours during Hallow's End. Genn Greymane grants this buff to all players standing in the small area in front of the wickerman at the end of his Wickerman Festival speech at Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest. Since the effect counts as an elixir of both types, it cannot be gained by players with an elixir already active; they should be canceled manually by the end of the speech. Furthermore, players must be standing to receive the buff, possibly because characters do a cheer animation when it is received. They may be mounted. Greg Capullo is a TCG artist. In addition to his work on World of Warcraft media, he has also penciled DC comics and co-created characters including The Batman Who Laughs and the Court of Owls. Among many other comics, he illustrated the cross-over books Dark Nights: Metal and Dark Nights: Heavy Metal, released from 2017 to 2021 and has worked on Spawn comics intermittently since 1993. Other illustrations he has worked on include album art for the bands Disturbed and Korn. He received a prestigious Inkpot Award in 2015.

Grimslice is a kobyss that walks around the Veneration Grounds in Hallowfall.

Grips of Ten Storms are part of the Impact of the Ten Storms set, the Tier 2 armor set for DPS Enhancement Shamans. They can be purchased from Victor Nefriendius in with Ancient Gloves. They can be traded to Duke Hydraxis in the for a "" version, which have the same stats but are part of the Earthfury Impact set.

Grips of Reclaiming Blight are part of the Roots of Reclaiming Blight, the tier 33 Liberation of Undermine set for druids. They can be obtained in a few different ways: *Using a Mystic Bloody Gallybux, which drops from the Cauldron of Carnage in the Liberation of Undermine raid *Kari Bridgeblaster in the Undermine for 1 Excessively Bejeweled Curio *Converting another pair of The War Within Season 2 gloves using the Catalyst

Grips of the Insatiable Vision are obtained from Horrific Visions Revisited. Explorer gear is obtained by completing a Horrific Vision with 0-4 objectives finished. Adventurer gear is given when a full clear is done with 1-4 masks active, while Veteran gear is rewarded after completion with at least 5 masks active. The cosmetic version is sold by Torie south of the Coreway in Dornogal for 400 Displaced Corrupted Mementos after completing the achievement We Have the Memories.
Grips of Fading Luminescence are sold by Auralia Steelstrike at Mereldar in Hallowfall for 250 Resonance Crystals.

Grips of the Woven Dawn are created with Khaz Algar Tailoring. The crafting recipe automatically learned after putting 10 points into the Dawnweave Tailoring subspecialization (From Dawn Until Dusk ⮞ Dawnweave Tailoring).
Grips of the Twisted Grove is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Vestments of the Twisted Grove.
Grimy Timekeepers are goblins found in Undermine that manage the Skyrocketing and G-99 Breakneck races; the Undermine equivalent of the Skyriding races.
Grips of Remembered Eternity is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Scales of Remembered Eternity.

Grips of Eredathian Sacrifice is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Vestments of Eredathian Sacrifice.
Grimrail Bombardiers are orcs found throwing bombs on the ramp section immediately after the first boss in the Grimrail Depot.
Grimrail Laborers are orcs found in the section before the first boss in the Grimrail Depot.
Grimoire of the Eternal Light drops from Vorasius in the Voidspire.
Grips of Forgotten Honor drop from Commander Kroluk in Windrunner Spire.
Grips of Threadless Control are a quest reward from Bury Me Not.
Grips of the Colossal Behemoths are a quest reward from Save a Piece of Mind.
The Grimy Creeper is a mire creeper found at the Endmire in Revendreth.
